mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.code FROM admin_roles ar JOIN role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = ar.role_id JOIN permissions p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} AND p.status = 1
SELECT r.code FROM admin_roles ar JOIN roles r ON r.id = ar.role_id WHERE ar.admin_id = #{adminId} AND r.status = 1
